title: Fare, Mirror, Square! Functions Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
A flat bus fare that never changes, a mirror that copies you exactly, and a square plot whose area grows four times when you double the side. Three everyday rules that look nothing alike. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 2, Relations and Functions) they become the constant function, the identity function and a polynomial function.

You will slide a constant line up and down, move a point along the identity line, and watch y = x to the n morph live as n counts from 0 to 3: a flat line, the identity, a parabola and a cubic. Then we test which formulas are polynomials and which are not. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example with x cubed - x squared + 2, the exam trap of judging the degree before simplifying, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:

3:11 Worked example: x cubed - x squared + 2
3:50 Exam trap: simplify before the degree
4:10 Where it is asked
4:22 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
